maps.name: Desert Canyons and Oases - Canyon Narrows Assembly
maps.scope: assembled canyon section, not the entire 88-model pack

notes: All 3D maps are downloaded once into public/assets/maps and loaded from local paths at runtime.
Run npm run assets:download while online once; after that the game does not request remote map files.
Enemy soldiers use the project's animated procedural tactical rig; no static posed character is loaded.
Imported GLB scenes provide visual geometry only; gameplay collision/navmesh remains project-owned.
Fonts use local system fallbacks; no Google Fonts request is made.
